messages:
anna-sales: Acme POC asked for a clear shared-responsibility table and an evidence checklist for CAIQ items (network logging, KMS, audit artifacts). Need a deliverable they can attach to the questionnaire by end of week.
ben-se: Clarify deployment mode? Hosted vs Dedicated changes what we own.
anna-sales: This is a Dedicated trial in their VPC using a reserved pool. They specifically asked how BYOK (customer-managed KMS) affects what we can provide.
charlie-sec: For Dedicated (Redwood-managed runtime, customer VPC) — high-level split: Redwood = model runtime, OS/host patching, runtime telemetry, service account activity. Customer = VPC config, Flow Logs, KMS key material and rotation policy, data classification and access controls. I'll map these to CCM/CAIQ control IDs and propose evidence artifacts for each.
devon-eng: Drafting artifacts we can hand over: sanitized serving runtime config JSON, runtime/kernel/version manifest, token-level request logs with identifiers blinded, deployment manifests (Helm/Terraform snippets), proof of patch/update cadence (package update log). We cannot provide unredacted prompt histories or raw KV cache contents.
charlie-sec: For CAIQ mapping, I'll attach CCM control refs (e.g., LOG-01/LOG-02 equivalencies) and list which artifacts satisfy each question. Evidence types: screenshots of audit settings, log extracts with masked IDs, signed attestations on process.
anna-sales: Customer also asked whether we can show KMS rotation audit entries if they BYOK.
devon-eng: If customer provides their CMK (BYOK), we can include audit logs showing our service principal called Encrypt/Decrypt or EnvelopeEncrypt operations. Example (sanitized) audit entry we can provide:
```
{
  "event":"Encrypt",
  "principal":"redwood-service-account@redwood-prod",
  "resource":"projects/acme/locations/global/keyRings/acme-ring/cryptoKeys/acme-key",
  "timestamp":"2026-03-18T14:22:31Z"
}
```
We will not expose key material.
charlie-sec: Note: VPC Flow Logs are controlled by the customer. We can provide our application/proxy logs (nginx, egress proxy) showing connection metadata, but network-level flow logs are their responsibility. Mark that clearly in the responsibility table.
anna-sales: They want an evidence delivery plan and a minimal template to include in the CAIQ responses. Can we commit to a timeline?
devon-eng: Proposed timeline: (1) Today: responsibility matrix + evidence checklist in this thread; (2) Tomorrow AM: security adds CCM mappings and redaction rules (Charlie); (3) Day 3: artifact bundle with manifest and sample redacted logs (Devon); (4) Friday EOD: final signed pack ready for POC submission.
charlie-sec: I'll include a README inside the artifact bundle explaining which items are Redwood-provided, which are customer-provided, accepted redaction/aggregation rules, and the exact CAIQ questions each artifact maps to.
elaine-legal: We need a short POC addendum to the MSA authorizing Redwood to share system-level logs and attestations for the POC. Sales should get customer sign-off before we hand over any signed artifacts.
anna-sales: On it — I will propose the addendum and ask the customer to sign by Friday.
ben-se: One technical ask from the buyer: a sanitized runtime config snippet showing KV cache TTL and prefix caching. Devon, can you provide a safe sample?
devon-eng: Safe snippet (no secrets):
```
{"runtime_version":"2.4.1","kv_cache_ttl_seconds":3600,"prefix_cache_enabled":true,"batching":{"max_batch_size":16,"latency_ms_target":50}}
```
charlie-sec: For encryption-in-transit CAIQ items, we'll include TLS config summary (cipher suites, minimum TLS version, cert rotation cadence) and cert thumbprints — never private keys.
anna-sales: Anything blocking the proposed timeline?
elaine-legal: Legal will review the addendum by tomorrow morning. If edits are required, we'll flag quickly so Sales can negotiate.
devon-eng: I'll assemble the draft artifact zip and upload to internal storage, then post link here when ready. Expect link by tomorrow midday.
redwood-deploy-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence-bucket/acme-poc/1719999999-acme-evidence-draft.zip
anna-sales: Great — once legal signs the addendum I'll share the draft with the customer. Thanks all :thumbsup: 
ben-se: I'll prepare a short CAIQ cover note that explains our assumptions (dedicated deployment, BYOK semantics, scope of redactions) to avoid confusion for their reviewers.
charlie-sec: I'll post the CCM mapping doc next with explicit control IDs and which artifact satisfies each control.
anna-sales: If the customer moves the deadline earlier, we'll triage. Otherwise, keep updates in this thread and ping if any blockers arise.
